title: Bioprinting and 3D Printing Human Body Parts
description: Revolutionizing available medical treatments with 3D printing and bioprinting. Collaboration between biomedical engineers, scientists and critically – clinicians. Ethical considerations and ramifications of technological advances. Includes a design project
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of BME 410, BME 401B (if taken in the same topic), BME 510.
A combined undergraduate and graduate course.
